ruleset.name: ArcClaw Code Size Gate
ruleset.description: Enforces maximum boundaries for class and method structures on JDK 25. NcssCount measures non-commenting source statements for method (80) and type (500). Note: ExcessiveLength was removed in PMD 7.x. NcssCount's typeReportLevel=500 serves as the file length gate (a 500-line file will have ~450+ NCSS lines).
